entries.summary: Collapsible Major, Minor, and Patch release navigation inside the existing Docs sidebar
entries.body: Every pull request targeting main now owns one validated, versioned release entry. Project Docs present those entries as a continuous release history with exact Preview and publication identity.
testing: Open the v0.4 release line on a wide desktop and confirm the existing Docs sidebar expands from v0 to v0.4 to v0.4.44.
Open the same release at 390 pixels wide and confirm each Summary, Changes, Upgrade, Preview tests, and References row stacks without clipping.
Use the keyboard to collapse and expand the release groups, then open v0.4.44 directly from the sidebar.
Open the direct v0.4.44 anchor, scroll through the continuous article, and confirm the active patch link follows the reading position.
Confirm there is no patch pagination or previous and next release control.
Confirm the article identifies Preview PR 409 and expected v0.4.44 from the exact deployed head revision.
Confirm What to test appears in this Preview while published release metadata remains marked not published.
